## API Reference

- [Agents](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/agents): Agents
- [Conversations](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/conversations): Conversations
- [Start a conversation](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/create-conversation): Creates a new conversation between a user and an AI agent.
- [Register a webhook](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/create-webhook): Registers a URL to receive real-time event notifications from Netomi.
- [Delete a webhook](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/delete-webhook): Removes a registered webhook endpoint.
- [Error Codes](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/error-codes)
- [Get an agent](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/get-agent): Retrieves details for a specific AI agent by ID.
- [Get a conversation](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/get-conversation): Retrieves the full details and message history of an existing conversation.
- [List agents](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/list-agents): Returns all AI agents available in your account.
- [List webhooks](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/list-webhooks): Returns all registered webhooks for your account.
- [Netomi API](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/netomi-api): The Netomi REST API provides programmatic access to AI agents, conversations,
- [Overview](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/overview)
- [Send a message](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/send-message): Sends a follow-up message in an existing conversation and returns the agent reply.
- [Webhooks](https://your-netlify-url.netlify.app/api-reference/webhooks): Webhooks
